import sys,json,hashlib,argparse
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();r=root/'.agent-runs/performance-v2';source=r/'drybean-native-source'
sys.path.insert(0,str(source));sys.path.insert(0,str(source/'benchmarks'))
import numpy as np
import sklearn_genetic
import benchmark_native_automl as b
assert Path(sklearn_genetic.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(source.resolve())
seed=int(sys.argv[1]);model=sys.argv[2];profile=sys.argv[3]
provenance=json.loads((r/'datasets/drybean-provenance.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert hashlib.sha256((r/'datasets/drybean.npz').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==provenance['npz_sha256']
def dataset(name):
 assert name=='drybean'
 with np.load(r/'datasets/drybean.npz') as d:return d['X'],d['y'],True
b.dataset=dataset
fraction={'full':1.,'quarter':.25,'eighth':.125,'native':1.}[profile]
label=f'drybean-native-{model}-{profile}-{seed}'
args=argparse.Namespace(evolutionary_model=model,methods=['flaml','autogluon'] if profile=='native' else ['gasearch','features'],label=label,seconds=15. if profile in ['full','native'] else 3.75,seeds=1,seed_start=seed,train_fraction=fraction,generations=1000,finalists=4,output=r/(label+'.json'),model_dir=r/'drybean-native-models',datasets=['drybean'])
b.run(args)
payload=json.loads(args.output.read_text(encoding='utf-8'));payload['drybean_provenance']=provenance;payload['profile']=profile
args.output.write_text(json.dumps(payload,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
scripts.summarize_drybean_native.py:
import json,hashlib,math,statistics as st
from pathlib import Path
r=Path('.agent-runs/performance-v2');rows=[];profiles={}
for seed in range(2401,2404):
 for model,profile in [(m,p) for m in ['svm','lightgbm'] for p in ['full','quarter','eighth']]+[('lightgbm','native')]:
  key=f'drybean-native-{model}-{profile}-{seed}';d=json.loads((r/(key+'.json')).read_text(encoding='utf-8'));profiles[key]={k:v for k,v in d.items() if k!='results'}
  assert len(d['results'])==2
  assert {x['method'] for x in d['results']}==({'flaml','autogluon'} if profile=='native' else {'gasearch','features'})
  fraction={'full':1.,'quarter':.25,'eighth':.125,'native':1.}[profile]
  assert d['settings']['train_fraction']==fraction and d['settings']['native_threads']==1
  for row in d['results']:
   assert row['dataset']=='drybean' and row['seed']==seed and row['train_samples']==10208 and row['test_samples']==3403
   assert row['requested_seconds']==(15. if profile in ['full','native'] else 3.75)
   assert math.isfinite(row['holdout_score']) and 0<=row['holdout_score']<=1 and math.isfinite(row['seconds']) and row['seconds']>0
   if profile!='native':
    assert math.isfinite(row['cv_score']) and row['evaluations']>0 and row['full_fold_sizes']==[6805,6805,6806]
    assert row['train_fold_sizes']==[max(1,int(size*fraction)) for size in row['full_fold_sizes']]
    assert (row['promotion_cv_calls']==0 if profile=='full' else 1<=row['promotion_cv_calls']<=4)
    if row['method']=='features':assert len(row['selected_mask'])==16 and sum(row['selected_mask'])==row['selected_features'] and 1<=row['selected_features']<=16
   rows.append(dict(model=model,profile=profile,**row))
assert len(rows)==42
manifest=json.loads((r/'drybean-native-source-sha256.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
for name,sha in manifest.items():assert hashlib.sha256((r/'drybean-native-source'/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==sha
provenance=json.loads((r/'datasets/drybean-provenance.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert hashlib.sha256((r/'datasets/drybean.npz').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==provenance['npz_sha256']
summary=[]
for model,method,profile in sorted({(x['model'],x['method'],x['profile']) for x in rows}):
 group=[x for x in rows if (x['model'],x['method'],x['profile'])==(model,method,profile)]
 assert len(group)==3
 summary.append(dict(model=model,method=method,profile=profile,score=st.mean(x['holdout_score'] for x in group),score_sd=st.stdev(x['holdout_score'] for x in group),seconds=st.mean(x['seconds'] for x in group),seconds_sd=st.stdev(x['seconds'] for x in group),features=st.mean(x['selected_features'] for x in group)))
lines=['PASS42finitefits;1CPU/settings,split sizes,mask bounds,training-fold fractions,promotion counts,source/data hashes.','Total fitting seconds: '+str(sum(x['seconds'] for x in rows))]
for g in summary:lines.append(f"{g['model']} / {g['method']} / {g['profile']}: score {g['score']:.6f} +/- {g['score_sd']:.6f}; seconds {g['seconds']:.3f} +/- {g['seconds_sd']:.3f}; features {g['features']:.2f}")
for model in ['svm','lightgbm']:
 for method in ['gasearch','features']:
  base=next(g for g in summary if (g['model'],g['method'],g['profile'])==(model,method,'full'))
  for profile in ['quarter','eighth']:
   g=next(g for g in summary if (g['model'],g['method'],g['profile'])==(model,method,profile));lines.append(f"{model}/{method}/{profile}: speedup {base['seconds']/g['seconds']:.3f}, accuracy delta {g['score']-base['score']:+.6f}")
text='\n'.join(lines)+'\n';print(text)
(r/'drybean-native-summary.txt').write_text(text,encoding='utf-8')
payload=dict(base_commit='78a9f2d46cf20c11f47194fd1bc13ce0fcfb7329',source_sha256=manifest,provenance=provenance,profiles=profiles,results=rows,summary=summary,scripts={name:(r/name).read_text(encoding='utf-8') for name in ['drybean_native_worker.py','run_drybean_native.py','summarize_drybean_native.py','prepare_drybean_data.py']})
(r/'drybean-native-combined.json').write_text(json.dumps(payload,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
scripts.prepare_drybean_data.py:
import io,zipfile,hashlib,json,urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from scipy.io import arff
r=Path('.agent-runs/performance-v2/datasets');r.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
url='https://archive.ics.uci.edu/static/public/602/dry%2Bbean%2Bdataset.zip'
with urllib.request.urlopen(url,timeout=60) as response:blob=response.read()
assert hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest()=='0a64eff5be87f48c3dbbfc0a12a56c5d5b5167ef8e61cd45d69b3e7c7130c06f'
with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(blob)) as archive:
 names=[name for name in archive.namelist() if name.lower().endswith('.arff')];assert len(names)==1
 data=archive.read(names[0])
assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()=='b2a4a76a2aedfb8ed415adfc1bfc70b5f202cb00cb72e500766e364c14834014'
records,metadata=arff.loadarff(io.StringIO(data.decode('utf-8')))
features=records.dtype.names[:-1];X=np.column_stack([records[name] for name in features]);y=records[records.dtype.names[-1]].astype(str)
assert X.shape==(13611,16) and y.shape==(13611,) and np.isfinite(X).all()
out=r/'drybean-rebuilt.npz';np.savez_compressed(out,X=X,y=y)
sha=hashlib.sha256(out.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert sha=='9af9ba904831e8e615aba1255c37dbdbdec73307439873118bed55fd628869d6',sha
print(json.dumps(dict(output=str(out),sha256=sha,shape=X.shape,classes=np.unique(y).tolist())))
